eridu-settled-sumer.description: A painted scene of a marsh landscape under a dark, stormy sky with a low sunlit glow on the horizon. In the foreground, bare-chested and tunic-clad men carry bundles of reeds and stack mudbricks in a wall. A large arched, reed-thatched hut with a wooden frame stands on a rise beside the wall, with a man on a scaffold binding reeds to it. Small figures in reed boats and wading in channels fill the middle ground. No text, frame or border is visible.

uruk-first-city-walled.description: A crowded mudbrick city seen from a raised rooftop. A large white temple with pilasters stands on a stepped terraced platform with stairways at the upper right. Flat-roofed houses fill the foreground and midground, with a long crenellated wall at the left edge. In the lower centre, a narrow street is packed with people carrying large baskets on their heads, and a few figures stand on rooftops. The sky is heavy and overcast, and the painting is warm brown and ochre. No visible text, frame or border.

cuneiform-writing-emerges.description: A bearded man in a rough grey tunic kneels in a dim room, head bowed, pressing a reed stylus into a small clay tablet cupped in his left hand. Baskets of grain sit beside him, with a large jar and a second basket behind, and a mat on the right holds rows of finished tablets covered in small wedge-like marks. Loose grain and wheat ears lie on the floor. The image is an oil-painting style, full bleed, with no frame or visible text other than the tablet marks.

royal-tombs-of-ur.description: A vaulted underground chamber with a shaft of light falling diagonally from an opening at upper left, showing a stepped ramp. In the centre foreground a gold bull's head with blue beard and horns sits on a carved wooden bier draped in brown cloth. Beside it a golden lyre with an inlaid panel stands at the front. A headless bust wearing a gold leaf headdress and layered red, blue and beaded necklaces rests on the right of the bier. Gold and silver cups, a bowl, daggers and a jar lie on the stone floor. Dim figures slumped or lying in the shadowed side areas.

urukagina-reforms-lagash.description: A painted street scene between mud-brick walls in hazy sunlight. A bearded, muscular man with a headband and a fur-fringed skirt raises one arm high while a younger man beside him holds up a clay tablet with wedge-like marks. Around them a crowd of ragged, poor townspeople looks on, and in the foreground a veiled woman in torn dark cloth crouches protectively over a child. On the right, two bearded men in layered robes and heavy jewellery gesture, with stacked pottery jars, baskets of grain and bundled goods piled at their feet. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame, no legible text and no gore.

enheduanna-hymns-inanna.description: A seated woman in a fringed red and brown layered robe, with a beaded necklace and bracelets, writes with a stylus on a clay tablet resting on her lap. She is barefoot in an open courtyard at dusk. Behind her, a mudbrick wall carries a relief of a walking lion and a star rosette, and a brazier of glowing coals sits at the right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

naram-sin-victory-stele.description: A tall pinkish carved stone slab with an arched top, filled with relief figures. At the top, a horned, bow-carrying figure stands on a mountain beneath star disks, a crescent and a sun. Below, rows of spear-carrying soldiers march in file, and on the lower right a heap of prone figures lies among the rocks. The background is dark, with torch flames at both side edges, in an oil-painted style.

elamites-sack-ur.description: A painted scene of a bearded, long-haired man in a torn tan robe, wrists shackled in front of him, walked between two helmeted guards with spears and a curved blade. Behind them stands a stepped, ramped ziggurat, and to the left a mudbrick town burns under heavy smoke. More armed men follow in the background. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame, and I see no legible lettering.

amorite-dynasty-babylon.description: A bearded man in a tan turban and a fringed woolen shawl stands in a mudbrick doorway, holding a short staff with a metal head. Armed men with spears stand behind him in the dark interior, and a woman in a dark headband and a second woman stand at his side. Sheep crowd the foreground, and a river with palms and distant mudbrick houses lies under a dark, stormy sky. The style is oil-painted, with no visible text, frame or wall-mounted canvas, and the painting runs edge to edge.

plimpton-322-tablet.description: A young man with dark hair and a loose linen shirt sits at a wooden table in a dim room, writing with a stylus on a flat clay slab that has a triangle drawn in it. Clay tablets with rows of wedge-like script sit on the table and on shelves, and a window of light is at the top. Blurred figures, possibly other students, are in the background. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
